source_title: WHO Pandemic Prevention Preparedness and Response Agreement
unit_or_scope: WHO Member States and global pandemic governance
direct_observation: The World Health Assembly adopted the agreement in May 2025 with equity surveillance health systems workforce local production supply chains and countermeasure access as core elements while the PABS annex and ratification remain next steps
closed_stage: global architecture commitments and implementation sequence
missing_stage: legal entry into force country execution pathogen access benefit sharing and local protection
next_test: follow annex ratification and national implementation into named project and community outcomes

source_title: WHO Pandemic Agreement countermeasure access mechanism
unit_or_scope: manufacturers WHO and countries needing vaccines therapeutics and diagnostics
direct_observation: Participating manufacturers are targeted to provide WHO rapid access to 20 percent of real-time production and the agreement seeks equitable timely access
closed_stage: intended access mechanism and policy target
missing_stage: actual production allocation delivery affordability cold chain acceptance and use
next_test: trace one pathogen countermeasure from production and allocation to delivery uptake and subgroup outcome

source_title: WHO strategic joint evaluation of global COVID-19 response
unit_or_scope: global health systems supply chains governance and public trust
direct_observation: The evaluation identifies health-system supply-chain-governance and trust vulnerabilities and emphasizes primary care early detection transparent reporting and equitable access
missing_stage: whether reforms persist and produce outcomes in the next emergency
next_test: compare evaluation recommendations with routine preparedness indicators and outbreak response records

source_title: The Pandemic Fund portfolio and progress evidence
unit_or_scope: 67 projects across 128 countries and six regions

missing_stage: sustained domestic finance worker retention lab operation response speed and local outcome
